user_approval: 就这样开始建模 先做三视图 要求建模细致 有玉石光泽，透光 青铜和金线有质感
reference_limitation: AI造型三视稿的底端侧宽和段长不是量规。数字尺寸优先；实际模型须另出同尺度正侧背三视。

materials.source: Cycles jade subsurface/transmission+volume absorption as appropriate, bronze/gold physically based metal
materials.runtime: opaque URP thickness-driven light transmission approximation; no glow in unlit test
materials.thickness: true mesh ray measurement, linear texture; documented metres-to-0..1 range, separate from AO

stages: first blockout with actual orthographic three-view + clay for parent shape review
high detail, atlas UV, real material bake, ray thickness and masks
cold FBX/GLB readback, asset QA, beauty/front-side-back/backlight renders
independent Unity material/fit sample, no replacement of formal scene
compatibility_limit: top latch and shoulder proposal must be remeasured against new shape; do not claim inherited compatibility; formal scene not edited
